posts.title: Books: Travels with Lisbeth by Lars Eighner
posts.description: Lars Eighner (1948-2021) became homeless at the age of 30 in 1988. He roamed the streets of Austin in Texas to scavenge food and other necessities for himself and his dog Lisbeth from big trash containers called dumpsters. posts.title: Culture and Clay: Kyoto’s Ceramics Legacy
posts.description: Kyoto is renowned as the cultural capital of Japan. The city is a veritable melting pot of traditional arts.
